text:
marta-support: Customer reported embedding regression after region failover — embeddings dropped from 128 -> 64 dims, downstream similarity scores failing and library error. They also saw a spike in latency around the same time. Request id: req_8f7c21a3. Example curl to repro included below.

samir-oncall: can you paste the exact request id(s) + the route/region info? also any client error logs? :eyes:

marta-support: pasted below. Route header we got from the customer: region: eu-west-1, routed->us-east-1 (failover). Request ids: req_8f7c21a3, req_8f7c21a4, req_8f7c21b0. client log: "embedding length mismatch: expected 128 got 64". repro curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-v1-large","input":"checkout this product"}'
```

jin-eng: quick check shows the request went to eu-west control plane but our smart-routing failed over to us-east due to a transient GPU OOM. Fallback policy picked a compatible-looking alias "embed-lite-0.7-q4" which is actually a different architecture and returns 64-dim vectors. That explains the dim mismatch.

jin-eng: we should never include lite embed variants in the fallback set for embed-v1-large — they are not compatible. I'll put a hotfix to tighten the alias compatibility rules.

sre-bot: [AUTOMATED] trace=req_8f7c21a3 status=200 model_selected=embed-lite-0.7-q4 region=us-east-1 latency_ms=4300 note="failover-route"

elaine-cs: customer also says they got 3 charges for the same batch request. any idea on billing side? they ran 3 retries because client errored.

marta-support: billing show 3 token events tied to those request ids, two of them are retries that succeeded after failover. Started a billing ticket to review credits.

jin-eng: root cause summary: 1) transient capacity pressure in eu-west triggered cross-region failover; 2) routing policy allowed a non-compatible variant as fallback; 3) client retried on mismatch causing duplicate billing. Secondary issue: tokenizer/config drift between variants can change embedding normalization — so even equal-dim variants could produce regressed similarity.

jin-eng: immediate mitigations I'm pushing now:
- remove embed-lite* variants from the fallback set for embed-v1-large across regions
- set a hard-blowback threshold to prefer queueing over cross-region fallback for embeddings workload
- add a model compatibility matrix check to the router (reject fallbacks that change output shape or tokenizer schema)

jin-eng: config snippet to pin model for customer (advise as workaround):

```json
{"route_policy": {"preferred_model_alias": "embed-v1-large@20250110", "allow_cross_region_fallback": false}}
```

ops: rolling the change now to control plane routing rules in eu-west. will block embed-lite* from being selected as fallbacks for embeddings. staging tested, deploying to prod in next 6m.

samir-oncall: for repro, please have the customer call with header X-Request-Id + include `X-Route-Trace` from our api response next time. also capture the full response headers (model_selected, model_version).

marta-support: noted, I've asked the customer to run this exact curl and attach response headers. I'll also offer a credit while we investigate. ticket INC-17227 created.

jin-eng: followup tasks:
- add unit tests that assert fallback variants preserve embedding dims/tokenizer_id
- add router validation hook to reject fallbacks that change schema
- write a short postmortem note once we verify billing hits and credits issued

ops: applied routing block. early telemetry shows new failover attempts now queue instead of cross-region routing. latency for queued requests looks stable, no new dim mismatches detected.

marta-support: Customer confirmed they re-ran the curl and now get 128-dim vectors. They accepted provisional credit and want an ETA on the guard rails.

jin-eng: ETA for guards and tests: 2 days for router validation + 1 day for deployment and verification. I'll own the rollout.

marta-support: thanks all. closing loop with customer and adding notes to INC-17227. :white_check_mark:
